items.special_treatment: Shaking is mentioned for overnight culture growth and for reactions, but no special shaking treatments are described beyond standard shaking/incubation.

Pilot-scale manufacturing was performed in a 50 L reactor with temperature controller. 13.2 kg of water was added into the reactor and stirred at 200 rpm. All other materials were added into the reaction by following order: ethyl acetate 7.5 kg, cyclohexene oxide 0.48 kg, NaOCN 0.6 kg. The final 1.2 kg wet cell biocatalyst was added into the reactor while temperature maintains at 25°C. The temperature was controlled by recycling the cold water for 29 hrs until 95% conversion.
